turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We want a ski trip in February but none of us are great skiers. I found three places.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a big famous resort with tons of slopes, lively nightlife, and prices to match.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A small family resort in the next valley, cheaper and quieter, with mostly gentle beginner runs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a ski school package, where lessons, boots and lift passes are all included in one price.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd look hard at the package, lessons make the week far more fun when you're still learning. If some of you are confident already, the small resort plus a couple of lessons could be cheaper. The famous resort is better saved for when you've improved.
